I’m a final-year Computer Engineering student at the International University of Rabat. What I enjoy most is the moment raw enterprise data becomes something a team can decide with: a dashboard, a forecast, a model that holds up.

A little about me

Before UIR I spent two years in the preparatory classes in Tangier. At university I chose the Big Data and Artificial Intelligence track, and I’ve since worked across the whole chain: Hadoop and Spark pipelines, Oracle and SQL Server warehouses, Azure services, and NLP and computer-vision models.

Two summers at Cognitus, an IBM Company, pulled all of that toward SAP. The first showed me how a company actually runs inside S/4HANA, from purchasing to sales to the books. The second let me build on top of it: General Ledger data flowing from S/4HANA into SAP Datasphere, then out as dashboards, a forecast and a budget model in SAP Analytics Cloud.

Outside class, I mentor high-school girls through the DigiGirlz programme. I work in Arabic, French, English and Spanish.

Two summers at Cognitus

An SAP Gold Partner and IBM company, at its delivery centre in Tangier.

  1. 15 June to 15 August 2026

    SAP Analytics Cloud consultant intern

    Data & Analytics practice, Cognitus, an IBM Company

    My end-of-year project: a finance analytics pipeline on SAP BTP, built on real General Ledger data.

    • Replicated General Ledger line items from SAP S/4HANA into SAP Datasphere
    • Modelled a star schema of one fact view and eight dimensions, exposed through an analytic model
    • Built a four-page dashboard in SAP Analytics Cloud for executives, controllers and analysts
    • Forecast monthly net income six months ahead with SAP Smart Predict
    • Built a departmental budget model driven by Data Actions in SAC Planning
    • Earned four SAP Learning badges in SAP Analytics Cloud along the way, then the SAP Certified Data Analyst – SAP Analytics Cloud certification in October 2026

  2. 1 July to 29 August 2025

    SAP S/4HANA intern

    Cognitus Consulting, Tangier

    A discovery internship that mixed functional and technical SAP consulting.

    • Followed purchasing, sales and accounting processes end to end on the Global Bike case
    • Practised the FI, CO, MM and SD modules in S/4HANA through SAP Fiori
    • Wrote my first ABAP programs and learned how WRICEF objects extend SAP
    • Explored SAP BTP and how AI could plug into business processes
